product.summary: Engineered the mobile warehouse companion for TradeflowBD's Thrift vertical — replacing paper-based stock checks and desktop-only registration with a Capacitor Android app featuring Google ML Kit barcode scanning, continuous batch queue operations, shelf/box audit with misplaced-item detection, bilingual operator UI, and atomic Supabase RPC registration that syncs instantly to the web admin dashboard via TanStack Query cache invalidation.
product.problem: Warehouse staff registering second-hand garments on a desktop ERP could not keep up with inbound shipment volume. Paper stock checks caused miscounts, misplaced items sat undetected for weeks, and barcode lookup required walking back to a PC.

valueProposition.targetCustomer: Warehouse Operators, Floor Managers & Second-Hand Retail Logistics Teams

items.painDescription: Floor operators had to haul garments to desktop PCs or hand-write paper intake sheets, causing massive intake delays during container arrivals.
items.gainTitle: On-Floor Mobile Registration with Photo Upload
items.gainDescription: Capacitor 8 Android app captures product photos directly via Capacitor Camera, uploads to Cloudinary CDN, and registers inventory in sub-seconds.

items.painDescription: Garments placed on incorrect shelf/box bins went unnoticed for weeks, showing as unavailable for sale while physically in the warehouse.
items.gainDescription: Operators scan boxes to verify expected stock, immediately detect misplaced items via live DB queries, and relocate them with one-tap atomic RPCs.

items.painTitle: Slow Single-Item Scanning & Form Navigation Fatigue
items.painDescription: Scanning barcode labels one-by-one with mandatory screen confirmation caused high operator fatigue and slow intake rates.
items.gainTitle: Google ML Kit Continuous Batch Queue Scanning
items.gainDescription: Hardware-accelerated continuous camera decoding with audio/haptic feedback queues dozens of scans for instant bulk location/status updates.

items.painTitle: Language Barrier for Warehouse Floor Staff
items.painDescription: Complex English ERP interfaces caused operator misclassification and required extensive supervision.
items.gainDescription: Complete high-contrast bilingual localization (বাংলা + EN) with persisted device locale and large touch targets designed for warehouse floors.

backend: Cloudinary (Direct Image Upload via Edge Function)

architectureSummary: Capacitor 8 Android app (Quasar/Vue 3) using Google ML Kit for hardware barcode decoding, Capacitor Camera for product photos, Cloudinary for image storage, and Supabase RPCs for atomic stock writes — companion to the TradeflowBD Thrift web admin.

keyDecisions.challenge: Unreliable Barcode Scanning in Warehouse Conditions
keyDecisions.decision: Integrated @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning with Google ML Kit on Android, auto-installing the scanner module on first use, with a camera overlay fallback when the native scan UI fails.
keyDecisions.outcome: Reliable Code-128 reads on thermal labels with permission handling, auto-zoom, and normalized barcode parsing.

keyDecisions.decision: Built continuous scan mode with a bulk action queue — operators scan many items in sequence, then batch-update shelf location or stock status in one RPC call.
keyDecisions.outcome: Eliminated per-item form navigation during peak intake; bulk operations use bulk_update_thrift_stock_locations and bulk_update_thrift_stock_statuses RPCs.

keyDecisions.decision: Designed Audit Mode — select a shelf/box, load expected items, scan to verify, flag missing items, detect misplaced stock via live barcode lookup, and relocate in bulk.
keyDecisions.outcome: Structured stocktake workflow with progress tracking, audio/haptic feedback, and one-tap bulk relocation for misplaced items.

keyDecisions.challenge: Operator UX in Noisy Warehouse Environments
keyDecisions.decision: Added audio chimes (success/error tones) and device vibration via scanFeedback utilities, plus contextual AppHelpDialog guides on every major workflow.
keyDecisions.outcome: Operators get instant scan confirmation without looking at the screen.

keyDecisions.decision: Mobile stock registration captures barcode, product photo (Capacitor Camera), metadata (brand, size, condition, weight, pricing), and registers atomically via register_thrift_stock_from_app RPC with Cloudinary image upload.
keyDecisions.outcome: Full garment intake at the warehouse shelf — data appears in TradeflowBD web admin immediately on cache refresh.

securityReliability: Supabase Auth with native Google Sign-In on Android (ID token) and browser OAuth on web.
Tenant-scoped session bootstrap with membership validation before any stock operation.
Atomic RPC for stock registration — no partial writes across thrift_stocks, thrift_barcodes, and thrift_stock_images.
Duplicate image detection per barcode/shipment before Cloudinary upload.
TanStack Query cache invalidation keeps stock list, detail, and dashboard metrics consistent after every mutation.
futureRoadmap: Offline-first IndexedDB queue for warehouse zones with poor connectivity.
Bluetooth thermal printer integration for on-the-spot barcode label printing.
Supabase Realtime subscriptions for live dashboard push (currently poll + cache invalidation).
